capabilities: Generate summaries from a text selection or the full active note using OpenAI models
Run summary, review, flashcard, and open-loop presets from the right-click context menu
Write output to the frontmatter, daily note, a new note, or below the selection
Create project, weekly, research, meeting, and open-loops digests from a folder of notes
Configure multiple profiles with model, prompt, system instructions, tokens, and destination
extras: Using the OpenAI API incurs usage costs; the README includes prompt engineering tips and explains chunking behavior for large inputs.
motivation: The acknowledgments say it was inspired by the community's need for practical AI-assisted note workflows.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to have AI condense note content into summaries, review material, or open-loop lists, or to digest many notes in a folder at once.

relations.evidence: uses OpenAI models to summarize notes

summary: AI summarization plugin that summarizes selections or whole notes with OpenAI models, writes results to chosen destinations, and builds folder-level digests.
